summary: Iteration 16 — Tested OD-Cashflow Calculator + Admin Analytics endpoints AND verified the Calculators.jsx mkFlowKey syntax-fix regression. Backend: 9/9 pytest passed (3 OD-CF plans rtm/20_80/subvention + 6 analytics: anonymous track, multi-route increment, 401 anon, 403 non-admin, full field shape, days param). Frontend: all 15 Calculator tabs (wealth/car/emi/rentbuy/invest/cashflow/rentcf/resale/optimizer/builder/uc/rtmuc/prepay/xirr/odcf) render without console errors after demo login — confirms mkFlowKey brace fix is clean. ODCF tab: odcf-calculate posts and odcf-result, odcf-xirr, odcf-narrative, odcf-series all populate. Admin Analytics tab: admin-analytics-panel + analytics-top-features + analytics-all-routes all visible; analytics-window-7 and analytics-window-90 toggles work; AnalyticsTracker is firing (panel showed 22 pageviews/90d, 8 unique sessions/24h, /app/calculators top route with 6 views/9.7s avg).
critical_code_review_comments: OdCashflowRequest+od_cashflow (server.py L5268-5436) is well-structured: builder-plan schedule helper, _buyer_upfront_pct floor, OD interest-offset math, narrative builder all factored. One minor math note: cashflow_cfs.append((m*30, net_cf - body.monthly_od_topup)) — subtracting the OD topup from the cashflow series is intentional (treats topup as cash already counted in OD growth, not as additional outflow), but the comment could make this clearer.
AnalyticsTrackIn truncates fields properly (route[:100], session_id[:64], time_on_page_ms clamped 0..24h, user_agent[:300]) — good defensive coding against abuse.

admin_analytics aggregation is correct: uses created_at as ISO string — string comparison works because ISO-8601 sorts lexicographically. Pipeline uses $addToSet on session_id for unique counts, $cond guard against zero-views division — solid.
Top-features filter `r['route'].startswith('/app/')` correctly distinguishes app routes from public pages. least_used_features sort ascending by views — semantically correct.
Auth gate on /api/admin/analytics: returns 403 for non-admin (verified), 401 for anon (verified). No bypass.
Calculators.jsx mkFlowKey brace fix: lint clean, all 15 tabs render in UI test — no JSX/JS error introduced.
AnalyticsTracker (frontend) is correctly wrapped in App.js and produces real events visible in admin panel — end-to-end loop verified.
Code-quality nit: server.py is now 5566 lines — domain-router split (calculators / analytics / lawyers / portfolio) is overdue. Not blocking but technical debt is accumulating.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (15/15 calc tabs + ODCF result + Admin analytics panel)
